Hi Jordan —

Hope you're well. We're getting Commercetech ready for a short integration audit and need your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter options for the most recent audit period. Specifically we need either:

- Full SOC 2 Type II report covering an audit window that overlaps our planned integration date (preferred), or
- If the most recent report's period ends before our integration window, a bridge letter that confirms no material changes since the report date.

Can you share the report (PDF) and let us know the audit period? If you prefer, you can upload to the S3 presigned path we'll provide or share via your secure FTP.

To make this fast for your team, attached is a short intake checklist (redwood-intake-checklist.xlsx) with the minimal items we typically need and a few one-line reply templates you can forward to your compliance team. If it's easier, I'm happy to accept an encrypted zip or a secure link.

Example one-line share template you can use: "Attaching Commercetech SOC 2 Type II report (period MM/DD/YYYY - MM/DD/YYYY). See bridge note if applicable."

Next steps we need from you:
- Confirm audit period for the report you plan to share
- Preferred transfer method (S3 presigned link or SFTP)
- Whether you have an existing bridge letter template (we can accept yours or provide a short sample)

Thanks — cc'ing Naomi from our security team for tracking.

Best,

Thanks Jordan — that audit window (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) is acceptable as long as we receive either:

A) The final Type II report PDF (redacted as needed) plus a short confirmation note that there have been no material changes since 2026-06-30 relevant to controls under the trust services criteria you were assessed on, OR
B) Your populated bridge letter that explicitly covers the gap to our integration date and any control changes.

For speed, Option A + a one-paragraph confirmation is the lowest-friction. If Security prefers Option B, your template is fine.

Minimal items our intake checklist requests (see attached):
- SOC 2 Type II report PDF (redacted OK)
- Statement of audit coverage dates
- List of any control exceptions or changes since report (if none, say so)
- Point of contact for auditor follow-up (name, email)

One-line answer templates your team can use to reply back: 
- "Attached: Commercetech SOC 2 Type II report (2025-07-01—2026-06-30). No material changes since period end."
- "Attached: Commercetech SOC 2 Type II report and our bridge letter (see attached bridge-sample.docx populated)."

Preferred transfer: presigned S3 link to s3://redwood-secure-shares/commercetech/ (we'll accept up to 2GB). If SFTP is required, Security, let us know host and creds method and we'll coordinate.

I'll also attach a short bridge letter sample and a one-page transfer instruction doc for your security team (bridge-sample.docx, transfer-instructions.txt).

If you can drop the report by end of day Thursday our side will mark the intake as complete and move to the next checklist step.

Best,
Jasmine
